notes: Landscape, straight-on, close-up of two shelves of computing books in a bookshop (labels 'Web Design', 'Web Marketing', 'SEO & Analytics'), even indoor light, in focus, no glare. English throughout, all from spines; duplicates (Don't Make Me Think, Web Words That Work, eBay Business All-in-One, Talking Back to Facebook) listed once, edition numbers dropped from titles. Corrections to the draft: Typography Sketchbooks (printed 'TYPO GRAPHY SKETCH BOOKS'), 'The Missing Manual' is WordPress: The Missing Manual, 'Can't I Buy Me Love' is Can't Buy Me Like, 'Google AdWords' is Ultimate Guide to Google AdWords, Microsoft Word 2013 is a QuickSteps not a Dummies, 'HTML & CSS For Dummies' is HTML & CSS: Design and Build Websites, 'Search Engine Optimization' is a For Dummies, 'Facebook' is the Teach Yourself Visually volume, 'Studio Visual Steps' is the publisher of Internet and E-mail for Seniors with Windows 8; 'Rocket Surgery Made Easy' is not on the shelf (both Steve Krug spines are Don't Make Me Think). Left out: the spine at the far left cut by the frame ('Bu...'), the WordPress Visual QuickStart Guide and the Sams 'in 10 Minutes' guides to Twitter and Vine (series spines with the topic only), and two spines partly hidden behind neighbours (a Microsoft Visual book, an SEO title).
